title: Do You Want to Join the Chinese Competition?
synopsis: Teacher Bai is chatting to Anne and Gao Tian, encouraging them to participate in the extracurricular international student Chinese speaking competition.

fullText.simplified:
你们想参加中文比赛吗

白老师：Anne，高天，下个月有每年一次的留学生中文比赛，你们想参加吗？
高天：白老师，比赛有什么要求？难吗？
白老师：要求用中文讲一个小故事。不难的，不用担心，也不用害怕。
高天：参加比赛的人多吗？
白老师：去年有八十多人参加了比赛。根据我的了解，今年的人会比去年多一点儿。
高天：我有点儿担心。我先想一想，明天再告诉您，好吗？
白老师：好的。Anne，你想参加吗？
Anne：白老师，我参加。
白老师：太好了！那你想想讲什么故事，好好准备一下。
Anne：好的。白老师，去年的比赛怎么样？
白老师：去年的要求和今年是一样的。去年参加比赛的留学生的中文都不错。
Anne：您觉得我和高天真的可以参加这个比赛吗？
白老师：当然，我相信你们。你们不但中文好，而且很聪明，没问题的。
Anne：明白了。这是重要的比赛，我会努力的。
高天：白老师，我也参加。
白老师：太好了。你决定了？
高天：决定了。Anne参加，我就参加。
fullText.traditional:
你們想參加中文比賽嗎

白老師：Anne，高天，下個月有每年一次的留學生中文比賽，你們想參加嗎？
高天：白老師，比賽有什麼要求？難嗎？
白老師：要求用中文講一個小故事。不難的，不用擔心，也不用害怕。
高天：參加比賽的人多嗎？
白老師：去年有八十多人參加了比賽。根據我的了解，今年的人會比去年多一點兒。
高天：我有點兒擔心。我先想一想，明天再告訴您，好嗎？
白老師：好的。Anne，你想參加嗎？
Anne：白老師，我參加。
白老師：太好了！那你想想講什麼故事，好好準備一下。
Anne：好的。白老師，去年的比賽怎麼樣？
白老師：去年的要求和今年是一樣的。去年參加比賽的留學生的中文都不錯。
Anne：您覺得我和高天真的可以參加這個比賽嗎？
白老師：當然，我相信你們。你們不但中文好，而且很聰明，沒問題的。
Anne：明白了。這是重要的比賽，我會努力的。
高天：白老師，我也參加。
白老師：太好了。你決定了？
高天：決定了。Anne參加，我就參加。

sentence_translations: Do You Want to Participate in the Chinese Competition?
Teacher Bai: Anne, Gao Tian, next month, there is an annual Chinese competition for international students. Do you want to participate?
Gao Tian: Teacher Bai, what are the requirements for the competition? Is it difficult?
Teacher Bai: The requirement is to tell a short story in Chinese.
It’s not difficult. You don’t have to worry, and you don’t have to be afraid.
Gao Tian: Are there many participants in the competition?
Teacher Bai: Last year, more than eighty people participated in the competition.
Based on my understanding, this year there will be a few more people than last year.
Gao Tian: I’m a little worried. Let me think about it first and tell you tomorrow, okay?
Teacher Bai: Okay. Anne, do you want to participate?
Anne: Teacher Bai, I will participate.
Teacher Bai: Great! Then think about what story you want to tell and prepare well.
Anne: Okay. Teacher Bai, how was last year’s competition?
Teacher Bai: Last year’s requirements were the same as this year’s.
The international students who participated last year had pretty good Chinese.
Anne: Do you think Gao Tian and I can really participate in this competition?
Teacher Bai: Of course, I believe in you both. Not only is your Chinese good, but you are also very smart. You’ll have no problems.
Anne: Got it. This is an important competition. I will work hard.
Gao Tian: Teacher Bai, I will also participate.
Teacher Bai: Great. Have you decided?
Gao Tian: I’ve decided. Since Anne will participate, I will participate too.
